status: frozen before numerical or symbolic instance solving
name: alternating six-node zero-set on a signed integer grid
omega_rule: all integer t from -6 through 6, inclusive
optional_blocks_rule: for j=0,...,9: include exponents 2*(j+1), 2*((3*j+4)%11+1), 2*j+3; block cost 1+((7*j+3)%5); remove duplicate exponents within a block
coefficient_domain: arbitrary rational coefficients in the span of selected monomials; no residual, square, or sign pattern supplied
objective: minimum total cost of selected blocks, then fewest blocks, then increasing bitmask
success: W=0 on the target and W>=1 on every off-target point; clearing rational denominators gives integral all-product stable weight
negative_control: remove the three even exponents of smallest numerical size that occur in any optimum found; recompute optimum or full infeasibility, without changing support or target
baseline: same exact oracle, exhaustive subset search sorted by the same objective
stopping: solve all 1024 architectures at most; exact certificates for every oracle answer; no claim of distributional generalization
